Only the documents and facts shown or obtainable through the offered checks are available. Unless expressly identified, the traveller has an ordinary passport, no additional citizenship, no destination residence, special passport, crew, e-Channel or other exemption. Short tourism only; no work. Routine entry permissions for an untested leg are not silently assumed when that leg is part of the puzzle.

Unfamiliarity alone is insufficient. No live airline or government systems are called.

attributes.category: Successful HK registration; notification slip held

clues: My ticket says airside, but this transfer message tells me to collect a bag.

questions.label: Resolve Tokyo baggage instructions
questions.response: The booking says through baggage, while the handling message says collect at arrivals. The transfer desk cannot establish which instruction applies; whether Japanese immigration is required remains unresolved.

questions.label: Ask for Japanese permission or alternative passport
questions.response: No Japanese visa, other passport, residence status, registration or other exemption is available.

rationale: Hong Kong permission is sufficient. The material gap is whether the Tokyo transfer actually requires entry, for which this traveller lacks Japanese permission. The airside label cannot settle conflicting operational evidence. Escalate after the available verification fails.
